seasons.name: Spring Awakening
seasons.tagline: Tender berries, sweet peppers, early greens, and crisp heirlooms
seasons.harvestNotes: Spring brings a flurry of early tender greens, crisp strawberries, sweet heritage tomatoes, and stone-baked saffron breads as winter chill recedes.
seasons.shopperTip: Arrive before 9 AM for the juiciest strawberries and heirloom seedlings before afternoon sun heats the stalls.

seasons.name: Summer Bounty
seasons.tagline: Sun-drenched golden mangoes, crispy okra, summer figs, and fragrant basils
seasons.harvestNotes: Summer is peak mango season! Mirpur Khas Sindhri and Chaunsa orchards deliver velvet sweet fruits alongside crisp morning okra, Malir ridge gourds, and purple figs.
seasons.shopperTip: Carry insulated cooler bags for farm cheeses and raw milk butter to protect them from high midday temperatures.

seasons.name: Autumn Harvest
seasons.tagline: Floral guavas, ruby pomegranates, mountain Sidr honey, and fig marmalade
seasons.harvestNotes: The season of transition fills stalls with intensely fragrant pink guavas, Kandahari ruby pomegranates, copper-pot fig marmalades, and raw wildflower honey.
seasons.shopperTip: Taste raw honeys from different forest valleys; autumn harvests feature unique botanical crystallization profiles.

seasons.name: Winter Frost Feast
seasons.tagline: Crisp winter carrots, mandarin citrus, tender spinach, and black sesame oil
seasons.harvestNotes: Cool sunny days produce the crunchiest red carrots, sweetest Kinnow citrus, mineral-dense winter spinach, and cold-pressed black sesame oils.
seasons.shopperTip: Stock up on root vegetables and citrus; cooler weather gives them maximum natural sweetness and shelf life.
